open_points.subject: A08/A09 base URL acceptance and join semantics
open_points.text: A08 rule 5: "one that is not an absolute `http` or `https` URL with a host counts as none"; A09 rule 1: "The URL is the `api_base_url` without a trailing `/` followed by the declared path".
open_points.question: Which additional `api_base_url` forms are valid (path/query/fragment/userinfo), and exactly how must the final URL be built in those cases?
options: Allow only origin form (`scheme://host[:port]`) and refuse any path/query/fragment/userinfo
Allow a base path and append declared path to it; refuse query/fragment
Allow any absolute URL with host and use literal string concatenation after trimming one trailing `/`
open_points.default_guess: Restrict to origin form only and refuse any base URL containing path/query/fragment/userinfo.

open_points.subject: A09 path placeholder parsing
open_points.text: A09 rule 2: "every `{name}` in the path takes the input port of that name".
open_points.question: How are malformed or ambiguous brace patterns handled (unmatched `{`/`}`, empty names, nested braces, or literal braces)?
options: Define a strict placeholder grammar and refuse any path not matching it
Treat non-matching brace text as literal path characters
Accept only placeholders matching known input-port names and otherwise refuse at proposal time
open_points.default_guess: Use a strict grammar and refuse malformed or ambiguous placeholder syntax during binding proposal.
